flash.timingScope: Completed process wall; diagnostic, not playback throughput.

execution.scope: Per-process wall includes model startup, inference, readback and disk writes. Sampled process-tree RSS/free disk and before/after power are diagnostic; no throughput claim or continuous power measurement.

independentAudit.scope: Independent current-payload arithmetic and provenance replay; comparison binds the exact analyzer report and CSV. Frame/pooled metrics agree exactly; no numerical tolerance or quality threshold is applied.

corrected.reason: Corrected advertised/API supported scales1/2/4; preserve earlier default4input and source unmodified
corrected.scope: CPU input preparation only; no model, GPU, window or capture

initial.scope: CPU input preparation only; no model, GPU, window or capture

inputPreparationHistory.scope: The advertised scale3 option was removed; supported scales are1/2/4. Both defaultscale4CPU generations passed. Earlier input/source remain retained; captures use corrected input-2.

limitations: Event24 and returned-input25...47 are reported separately; no frame is excluded from metrics.
Returned-input differences are observations after the earlier flash, not proof of ghosting or an ideal-target error.
Public historyReset/usedModel/motionRequested fields do not identify selected flow backend or reset cause.
No noise/history isolation, quality threshold, causal percentages, playback or physical HDR acceptance.
Capture provenance is compared and retained; historical binary/model/source identifiers are not claims that those files were re-executed or rehashed by this analyzer.
Raw input/output pixels and model files are retained separately and are not embedded in this public evidence.
Private noise indices, incoming history, flow arrays and confidence are not observed in these four-view captures.
metricDefinition: Float64 conversion before subtraction: C=E_C-O_C, F=E_F-O_F, D=F-C at the SAME ordinal. All RGB components equally weighted; no luminance weighting.
pooledDefinition: RMS=sqrt(sum of per-component squared residuals / total component count); never the mean of frame RMS values. Max ties choose earliest ordinal then row-major RGB component.

recipe.capturePolicy: Separate fresh persistent processor per arm; supply all48frames. Keep normal automatic motion, noise/history evolution and reset policy. Event metadata is observation truth, not a reset directive.
recipe.operation: Elementwise Float32 multiply by exactly1.5 after the static scene's Float32 construction; no clipping.
recipe.pairing: Control and flash share exact ordinals, PTS=index/30, duration=1/30 and all original bytes except flash frame24.
recipe.scene: Pinned occlusion generator scene_assets(scale), render(index=0); held static for every frame.
recipe.scope: Paired synthetic linear BT.2020 working inputs with one declared global luminance transient. CPU preparation only; no neural output, reset decision, perceived quality, decoded HDR stream, physical presentation or source-rate qualification.

resetScope: Observed public flags; no specific cause or actual motion backend established.
scope: Two serial48-frame synthetic captures on the retained production runtime; no production policy or model change.
